book.name: Lukas
book.title: Ramatua Yesus Tutui Malole na tuka Lukas susura na

content: Foa ela masoda tadaluꞌ a, fo matafali mai tuka Manetualain hihii-nanaun
Faiꞌ ria, lahenda rafada Yesus rae, gubernor Pilatus a naisa lahenda Yahudi hida reme Galilea mai, tepoꞌ fo ara reni tutunu-hohotuꞌ nai Uma Mamaso Ina nai Yerusalem.
Yesus namanene leoꞌ na, boe ma nafada ni nae, “Emi dale mara mae Manetualain namate lahenda Galilea sira, nana huu sala nara bau lahenda Galilea fekeꞌ?
Tuka Au sona sala ria! Tehuu kalu emi ta saledale-tuꞌetei mara meme sala-siko mara mai, sona emi malulutuꞌ leoꞌ sira boe.
Boe ma lahenda kasanahulu faluꞌ fo riꞌ manara nai Siloam refa neu de nanete naisa si a, nana sira sala nara bau lena basa lahenda fo rai Yerusalem, do?
Tuka Au sona sala ria! Tehuu kalu emi ta saledale-tuꞌetei mara meme sala-siko mara mai, sona emi malulutuꞌ leoꞌ sira boe.”
Ai huuꞌ fo ta naboa fa, sama leoꞌ Manetualain lahendan fo buna-boaꞌ taꞌa
Boe ma Yesus nafada dedea nasasamaꞌ esa nae, “Lahenda esa nanuu ai huu
esa nai oka na daleꞌ. Ana mai kokosen fo saka ai huuꞌ ria naboa na. Tehuu boaꞌ bei ta.
Boe ma ana nafada mana noi okaꞌ a nae, ‘Teuꞌ telu ian, au mai kokosen fo saka ai huuꞌ ia boa na, tehuu au ta hapu boaꞌ esa boeꞌ. De loꞌo henin, huu fo ana naseseka nahenu mamanaꞌ a.’
Tehuu mana noi okaꞌ a sipoꞌ nae, ‘Papa bosoꞌ mamanasaꞌ. Neme na fo teu ia au fufuꞌa-aali ai huuꞌ ia, ela nalole seluꞌ dei.
Bate manafaliꞌ boe ma ana naboa, sona malole a. Tehuu maneniko taꞌa, sona dei loꞌo henin.’ ”
Ramatua Yesus puli na ina kotiai pukudouꞌ a, laꞌe fai huhule-haradoiꞌ
Laiꞌ esa de, Yesus neu nanori-nafada nai uma mamasoꞌ daleꞌ, laꞌe lahenda Yahudi ra fai huhule-haradoin.
Nai naa hapu inaꞌ esa pukudou ni teuꞌ sanahulu falu so, huu fo nitu a tataon. Ana ta bisa napadei natetu fa.
Yesus nita inaꞌ ria, boe ma Ana naloo nan, de nafada ni nae, “Mama! Besaꞌ ia mama ka teꞌe ma aom so.”
Boe ma Yesus fua lima na neuꞌ inaꞌ ria, no hatemataꞌ ria boe kotiꞌai pukudou na namaroo na aon tutiꞌ a. Boe ma ana hule makasi, ma io-oa neuꞌ Manetualain.

Tehuu uma mamasoꞌ ria malaka na namanasa, huu fo Yesus puli na lahenda laꞌe fai huhule-haradoiꞌ. Boe ma ana nafada lahenda kadodou inaꞌ ara nae, “Nai mamasoꞌ esa daleꞌ, fai nonoi-tataoꞌ faiꞌ nee. De, malole lenaꞌ lahenda kamahedis ara saka lahenda fo puli si, sona ara mai laꞌe fai sira. Bosoꞌ mai laꞌe fai huhule-haradoiꞌ!”
Tehuu Yesus nataa ni nae, “Ae! Lahenda masaroleꞌ masaraliꞌ emin. Nai fai huhule-haradoiꞌ boe emi moi nonoiꞌ, hete?! Huu fo emi meu poꞌi sapi mara ma keledei ra fo hani si, hete?!
Inaꞌ ia, nana baꞌi Abraham tititi-nonosin, sama leoꞌ ita. Malaka nitu heke nan teuꞌ sanahulu falu ian so. Maneniko Au poꞌi an laꞌe fai huhule-haradoiꞌ sona, sala do?”
Yesus musunoo nara ramanene ra ria, boe ma ara maeꞌ. Tehuu lahenda kadodou inaꞌ sira ramahoꞌo huu fo Ria nonoi-tatao malole nara.
Ramatua Yesus fee nasasamaꞌ laꞌeneuꞌ ai deke anaꞌ a
Boe ma Yesus dedea naroo nae, “Au asasamaꞌ Manetualain lahenda nara sama leoꞌ ubeaꞌ?

Masososa na sira noi baianaꞌ asa, tehuu doo-doo boe ma ara tamba dodouꞌ. Sira mulai sama leoꞌ ai deke anaꞌ a. Lahenda sele ni nai okaꞌ. Basa de ana mori boe ma dadi neuꞌ ai huu bauinaꞌ. De, manupuiꞌ ara rarunu reuꞌ baꞌe nara.”
Ramatua Yesus fee nasasamaꞌ laꞌeneuꞌ ralu teteiꞌ a
Basa boe ma Yesus dedea bali nae, “Au asasamaꞌ Manetualain lahenda nara no ubeaꞌ bali?
Ria sama leoꞌ ralu teteiꞌ a fo inaꞌ ara ame rabua ni no uuꞌ saku dua,
ela tao roti dodouꞌ. Boe ma uuꞌ mana ameꞌ ria ae losaꞌ bauꞌ basa, huu no ralu tetei kabaianaꞌ ria. Manetualain lahenda nara lelea-nonoren namaloa-namanaru leoꞌ na boe.”
Nusatetu-ikutemaꞌ a lelesu na loaanaꞌ a
Basa ria boe ma, Yesus mulai laꞌo leo kota Yerusalem neu. Ana tuli lalaꞌo kota ma koroꞌ ara, fo nanori-nafada lahenda ra.
Nai mamanaꞌ esa, hapu lahenda esa natane Ni nae, “Papa Mesen! Noi lahenda baianaꞌ a riꞌ bisa hapu soda-moleꞌ a, do?”
Ana nataa nae, Lelesu fo leo nusatetu-ikutemaꞌ a neu a, loaanaꞌ a. De, tia mahereꞌ ei mara fo bisa kodi mesiꞌ na. Huu fo lahenda dodouꞌ soba nau masoꞌ reu, tehuu ta bisa fa.

Maneniko manuu umaꞌ a, koe na lelesu a so, neuꞌ ko emi mapadei mahaniꞌ deaꞌ fo dedelu lelesu a, ma maloo hule tutulu-fafaliꞌ mae, ‘Ramatuaꞌ! Soi lelesu a dei!’ Tehuu neuꞌ ko ana nataa nae, ‘Emi nana, bea? Au ta alelaꞌ emi fa!’
Tutiꞌ a emi mae, ‘Hapun nai bea papa ta malelaꞌ ami fa? Ami biasa mia-minu mo papa. Papa boe manori-mafada ami nai ami eno-dala mara.’
Boe ma neuꞌ ko Ana nataa nae, ‘Bisinaꞌ a au afada so, au ta alelaꞌ emi fa! Emi ia nana, lahenda mana tao tadaluꞌ. Madoo bai iaꞌ e!’

Faiꞌ bea ma Manetualain naetuꞌ basa lahenda ra dedea nara, emi boreu ma heku nisi mara. Huu fo emi mita baꞌi Abraham, baꞌi Isak, baꞌi Yakob ma Manetualain mana nesi mata nara basa si masoꞌ rai nusatetu-ikutemaꞌ a de ratuuꞌ so. Tehuu emi sona nanausi heniꞌ leo deaꞌ meu.
Neuꞌ ko lahenda reme dae-bafoꞌ ia bukun haas mai, reme ledo a titii mai na losa tetena neu na; reme ii mai losa ona, fo ratuuꞌ raa-rinu reuꞌ esa, nai Manetualain uma mane na.

Tanda matalolole hata ia: Maneniko Manetualain naetuꞌ basa lahenda a dedea na, neuꞌ ko hapu lahenda fo maulu na naendobuko ria nana lahenda aanaꞌ, tehuu ana hapu hada-horomata bauinaꞌ a, sekonaa te Manetualain tao ni neuꞌ lahenda aanaꞌ.”
Ramatua Yesus dale na tuda neuꞌ kota Yerusalem a lahenda nara
Tepoꞌ ria, lahenda Farisi hida mai de rasare ra Yesus, boe ma rafada rae, “Malole lenaꞌ, Papa Mesen maheoꞌ dooꞌ a leo mamana fekeꞌ muu, huu fo mane Herodes a nau naisa Papa.”

Boe ma Yesus nataa si nae, “Ae! Tou ria hada-parin sama leoꞌ ue a! Emi meu mafadan mae, ‘Fai ia no balahaaꞌ, Au usi nitu, ma puli a lahenda kamahedis ara. Binesaꞌ, dei basa Au nonoi Ka.’ Tehuu Au muste oi-tao a seluꞌ baiꞌ, fo dei leo Yerusalem uu. Huu fo nai Yerusalem nana mamanaꞌ fo raisa Manetualain mana nesi matan.

Adoo, Yerusalem lahendan emin, e! Emi riꞌ maisa Manetualain mana nesi mata nara, ma pia maisa lahenda nadedenuꞌ fo nau mai ratudu emi enoꞌ a. Laꞌi-laꞌi Au anea-asalaꞌe emi neme tadaluꞌ a mai, sama leoꞌ manu inaꞌ a nasuru-nahapaꞌ ana nara rai dila na daleꞌ. Tehuu emi ta nau fa.
Besaꞌ ia, Manetualain ta tao daleꞌ neuꞌ emi uma mamaso mara fa. Basa nate balahaa-binesaꞌ te rouꞌ so. Neuꞌ ko emi ta mita Au so, losaꞌ faiꞌ bea emi manaku mae,

content.text: ‘Manetualain fee ua-naleꞌ neuꞌ lahenda fo, ana mai neni Ramatuaꞌ a nade na,
huu fo Ramatuaꞌ a riꞌ nadenu Ni!’ ”

footnotes.text: Dedea Indonesia a pake dedeaꞌ ‘pohon ara’ neme dedea Yunani sona sukei. Tehuu Susura Makamoiꞌ a natudu ai huuꞌ esa nai na lahenda bisa raa boa na. Nai Indonesia poꞌ dulu, lahenda ta raa ‘pohon ara’ a boa na fa. De, ‘pohon ara’ fo nai Susura Makamoiꞌ daleꞌ, ta sama no ita ai kaꞌ nara fo nai ia fa.
Dedea Yunani a nae uuꞌ sata telu. Sata esa, sona bate liter sanahulu dua. De, sata telu, sona uuꞌ liter telu hulu nee.
